title: Jacob's Family Settles in Egypt

questions.question: Where did Pharaoh allow Jacob's family to settle?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:6: Pharaoh told Joseph to settle his family in the best of the land, in the land of Goshen.

questions.question: Did Jacob bless Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:7: "Then Joseph brought in Jacob his father and stood him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh."

questions.question: How old was Jacob when he stood before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:9: "Jacob said to Pharaoh, 'The days of the years of my sojourning are 130 years.'"

questions.question: Where did Jacob want to be buried?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:30: "Let me lie with my fathers. Carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burying place."

questions.question: How many years did Jacob live in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:28: "Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years."

questions.question: What did the Egyptians give Joseph in exchange for food during the famine?
options: Their money, livestock, land, and themselves
questions.correctAnswer: Their money, livestock, land, and themselves
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:18-21: The Egyptians progressively gave money, livestock, land, and themselves for food.

questions.question: What percentage of crops did Joseph require from the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:26: "Joseph made it a statute...that Pharaoh should have the fifth."

questions.question: How old was Jacob when he died?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:28: "The whole age of Jacob was 147 years."

questions.question: What did Jacob make Joseph swear?
options: To bury him in Canaan, not Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: To bury him in Canaan, not Egypt
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:29-30: Jacob made Joseph swear to carry him out of Egypt and bury him with his fathers.

questions.question: How did Jacob describe his years?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:9: "Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life."

questions.question: Whose land was exempt from Pharaoh's purchase?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:22: "Only the land of the priests he did not buy, for the priests had a fixed allowance from Pharaoh."

questions.question: How many brothers did Joseph present before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:2: "From among his brothers he took five men and presented them to Pharaoh."

questions.question: What did Joseph give the people in exchange for their land?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:23: "Then Joseph said to the people, 'Behold, I have this day bought you and your land for Pharaoh. Now here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.'"

questions.question: What did Jacob do after Joseph swore his oath?
options: Israel bowed himself upon the head of his bed
questions.correctAnswer: Israel bowed himself upon the head of his bed
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:31: "Then Israel bowed himself upon the head of his bed."

questions.question: What happened to the Israelites in Goshen?
options: They were fruitful and multiplied greatly
questions.correctAnswer: They were fruitful and multiplied greatly
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:27: "Thus Israel settled in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen. And they gained possessions in it, and were fruitful and multiplied greatly."

key_verse_text: Thus Israel settled in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen. And they gained possessions in it, and were fruitful and multiplied greatly.
